items.stem: Which cost is included in the initial cost of an item of property, plant and equipment?

options.text: The costs directly attributable to bringing the asset to the location and condition for its intended use
options.rationale: Correct: directly attributable costs are capitalised.

options.text: The cost of staff training unrelated to the asset
options.rationale: General training is not a directly attributable cost of the asset.

options.text: Administrative overheads of the whole entity
options.rationale: General administration is not capitalised into the asset.

options.text: Future repair costs expected over the asset's life
options.rationale: Future repairs are expensed when incurred, not capitalised at recognition.

items.explanation: Correct: directly attributable costs are capitalised.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about the revaluation model in IAS 16 are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A revaluation increase is generally recognised in other comprehensive income and accumulated in a revaluation surplus
options.rationale: Correct: increases go to OCI/revaluation surplus (except reversing a prior decrease).

options.text: If the revaluation model is used, revaluations must be kept sufficiently up to date
options.rationale: Correct: revaluations must be regular enough that carrying amount does not differ materially from fair value.

options.text: Revaluation increases are always recognised in profit or loss
options.rationale: Increases go to OCI unless reversing a previous decrease recognised in P&L.

options.text: Only one asset in a class may be revalued
options.rationale: The whole class must be revalued, not a single item.

items.explanation: Correct: increases go to OCI/revaluation surplus (except reversing a prior decrease).

items.stem: A company changes the estimated useful life of a machine from 10 to 7 years partway through its life. How is this change accounted for?

options.text: Prospectively, by depreciating the remaining carrying amount over the revised remaining life
options.rationale: Correct: a change in estimate is applied prospectively.
A change in estimate is not applied retrospectively.

options.text: By writing the asset off immediately
options.rationale: The asset is not written off; depreciation is simply re-spread.
The revised life changes future depreciation.

items.explanation: Correct: a change in estimate is applied prospectively.
